beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the four adoption states: attention, trial, repeated use, and reorganized work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then compare one real practice against visibility, permission, and retained learning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later cases test these concepts against technologies whose expected success never arrived.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to distinguish a popular tool from a practice that can justify its place.
